definitions.explanation: Living for many years; having a long lifespan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長生|ながい}き⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother lived a long life.

examples.japanese: {長生|ながい}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘訣|ひけつ}→秘訣：13750_hiketsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{長生|ながい}き⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live a long, healthy life.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long) + ⟦{生|い}き→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧ (living)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {長生|ながい}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to live long)
- {長生|ながい}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘訣|ひけつ}→秘訣：13750_hiketsu⟧ (secret to longevity)
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{長寿|ちょうじゅ}→長寿：14478_chouju⟧ (health and longevity)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧ (lifespan)
- ⟦{長寿|ちょうじゅ}→長寿：14478_chouju⟧ (longevity - more formal)
- ⟦{短命|たんめい}→短命：16693_tanmei⟧ (short life)

Japan is known for having one of the longest life expectancies in the world, making {長生|ながい}き a culturally significant concept.
